'''August 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA on 26 August 2000. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1174">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-28-los-gatos-san-jose-ca-8-26d1174/ los-gatos-san-jose-ca-8-26], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 28 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-28-los-gatos-san-jose-ca-8-26d1174/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
